limitations.effect: The compact source index correctly retains the raw input fingerprint, but the synthetic error payload originally has a null source_fingerprint_sha256. Reconstruction currently inserts the raw fingerprint, so exact full-payload equality is not guaranteed on this exceptional path.
limitations.trial_observation: The 2,926-row local fixture had zero parse-error rows, so its 2,926/2,926 equality result does not exercise this path.
limitations.release_consequence: Repair and add a forced-exception regression before production use. The bounded storage trial remains interpretable for its observed zero-error inputs.

limitations.scope: artificial caps smaller than fixed empty-Parquet footer overhead
limitations.effect: A cap stop before the first row still creates four empty Parquet files. The test cap of one byte therefore demonstrates pending-row checkpoint behavior, not a literal one-byte directory bound.
limitations.trial_observation: The real trial partitions 249 MB across four inputs and separately checks aggregate persistent bytes against 250 MB.
limitations.release_consequence: Add an explicit minimum-cap/footer reserve invariant before exposing arbitrary cap values.

limitations.effect: The bounded trial uses 128 or 256 row groups, so Parquet metadata overhead is higher than a later production layout may require.
limitations.release_consequence: Benchmark larger row groups before population-scale planning; do not extrapolate the bounded ratio as a formal full-corpus forecast.
